rules.content:
/*
DarkRace ransomware
*/

rule DarkRace_Ransomnote
{
    meta:
        author = "ransomware.live"
        family = "ransomware.darkrace"
        description = "Detects DarkRace ransomware ransom note"
        date = "2026-05-04"
        severity = 7
        score = 70

    strings:
        $s1 = "DarkRace" ascii nocase
        $s2 = "DARKRACE" ascii
        $s3 = "darkrace.onion" ascii nocase

    condition:
        any of them
}
